home_hero_sub: Small inns nestled in Tohoku's mountain valleys and coastlines — best rates & points rewards on the official site

home_member_sub: Earn up to 3% points on every stay. Points can be used immediately on your next booking. Valid at all properties · Free to join.

membership_lead: Earn points every time you stay, and make your next booking even better value. Membership is free.
membership_free: Free to join — just an email address to start
membership_how_body: You earn points on your accommodation charge (before tax) at a rate based on your grade. 1 point = 1 yen, usable on future bookings. Points are valid for one year from the date earned.
membership_rank_note: Your grade rises with the number of nights you stay each year, increasing your reward rate.
membership_benefit_advance_b: Book far-future dates not sold on other OTAs, exclusively and at a discount, before anyone else.
membership_benefit_personalize_b: Customize your stay — swap the in-room fridge contents, add amenities, and more.
membership_benefit_datechange_b: Flexibly change your dates, party size, room, plan, meals and options even after booking.
membership_change_lead: Even after booking, members can flexibly change and arrange the following.
membership_change_date_b: Change your stay dates online until 9:00 AM on your check-in day. Turn one night into two, or vice versa, in a few taps.
membership_change_guests_b: If the number of people joining you changes, update it easily online.
membership_change_room_b: For a richer stay, change your room or plan too. Switch plans flexibly to suit your mood.
membership_change_options_b: Arrange meals, spa & massage, activities and more. It can be harder to book after check-in, so arranging ahead is recommended.
membership_change_note: A member benefit that lets you change and arrange all of the above flexibly.
membership_benefit_cancel_b: More favorable cancellation terms according to your membership grade.
membership_benefit_points_b: Earn points on stays and use them (1pt = 1 yen) on future bookings.
membership_benefit_plans_b: Special plans and rates available only to members.
membership_benefit_favorites_b: Save your favorite rooms for smoother future bookings.
membership_benefit_otayori_b: Receive bonus points when your letters are featured and more.
membership_benefit_community_b: Share the latest news and stay memories with other members.
membership_cta2_body: Membership is free. With just an email address, you can start earning points right away.
